questions.stem: 相較於工廠量產的商品，職人（craftsmen）的作品長期以來被視為耐心與專注的最佳象徵。
questions.answer: Compared with goods mass-produced in factories, the works of craftsmen have long been regarded as the best symbols of patience and concentration.
accepted_answers: Compared to mass-produced factory goods, the works of craftsmen have long been seen as the best symbol of patience and focus.
In comparison with products mass-produced in factories, works by craftsmen have long been viewed as the finest symbols of patience and concentration.

questions.stem: 面對機器的激烈競爭，許多職人（craftsmen）仍堅持慢工細活，這讓他們的作品更顯珍貴。
questions.answer: Facing fierce competition from machines, many craftsmen still insist on working slowly and carefully, which makes their works even more precious.
accepted_answers: Faced with fierce competition from machines, many craftsmen still insist on doing slow and careful work, which makes their work all the more valuable.
Facing intense competition from machines, many craftsmen still stick to working slowly and meticulously, which makes their creations more precious.

1.explanation_zh: 「相較於工廠量產的商品」用比較片語 Compared with goods mass-produced in factories 放句首（compared 是過去分詞，不要寫成 Compare 或 Comparing）；「量產的」是 mass-produced。「長期以來被視為」從過去延續到現在，作品是「被」視為，用現在完成式被動 have long been regarded as。「耐心與專注的最佳象徵」是 the best symbols of patience and concentration（或 focus），of 後面兩個都用名詞。
evidence: 相較於工廠量產的商品
1.strategy_zh: 「相較於 N」→ Compared with N,；「長期以來被…」→ have long been p.p.。
hints: 切成四段：相較於工廠量產的商品／職人的作品／長期以來被視為／耐心與專注的最佳象徵
標的詞彙：compare（比較）、factory（工廠）、mass-produced（大量生產的）、goods（商品）、work（作品）、regard（視為）、best（最佳的）、symbol（象徵）、patience（耐心）、concentration（專注）
句型框架：Compared with + N, S + have long been regarded as + the best + N

2.explanation_zh: 「面對機器的激烈競爭」省略的主詞是後面的「許多職人」，用分詞構句 Facing fierce competition from machines,（或 Faced with …）。「仍堅持慢工細活」是 still insist on working slowly and carefully，insist on 後面接動名詞，「慢工細活」要譯出意思。「這讓他們的作品更顯珍貴」的「這」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 , which makes their works even more precious（which 前面一定要有逗號，不能用 that）。
evidence: 這讓他們的作品更顯珍貴
2.strategy_zh: 句首「面對…」且主詞在後→分詞構句；句尾「這讓…」指前面整件事→, which + V。
hints: 切成四段：面對機器的激烈競爭／許多職人仍堅持／慢工細活／這讓他們的作品更顯珍貴
標的詞彙：face（面對）、fierce（激烈的）、competition（競爭）、machine（機器）、insist on（堅持）、slowly（慢慢地）、carefully（仔細地）、make（使）、work（作品）、precious（珍貴的）
句型框架：V-ing + N, S + still insist on + V-ing …, which makes + O + even more + adj.

references: Compared with goods mass-produced in factories, the works of craftsmen have long been regarded as the best symbols of patience and concentration.
Compared to mass-produced factory goods, the works of craftsmen have long been seen as the best symbol of patience and focus.
In comparison with products mass-produced in factories, works by craftsmen have long been viewed as the finest symbols of patience and concentration.

traps.zh: 相較於工廠量產的商品
traps.literal_error: Compared with factory mass produce goods, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「工廠量產的商品」修飾語在前，英文寫成 goods mass-produced in factories 或 mass-produced factory goods；照字面排成 factory mass produce goods 不成英文。

traps.literal_error: The works of craftsmen were regarded as the best symbols of patience and concentration for a long time.
traps.explanation_zh: 「長期以來」表示從過去持續到現在，要用現在完成式被動 have long been regarded as；用過去式等於說現在不再如此。

bonus.text: Unlike mass-produced factory goods, the works of craftsmen have long stood as testaments to patience and concentration.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 stand as a testament to（是…的明證）代替 be regarded as，語氣更正式；Unlike 只是加分寫法裡的換句話說，作答時「相較於」仍以 Compared with 為準。

1.restructuring_zh: 「相較於…」用過去分詞片語 Compared with … 放句首，後面的主要子句不必再用比較級；「長期以來被視為」從過去延續到現在，用完成式被動 have long been regarded as；「工廠量產的商品」寫成 goods mass-produced in factories；「最佳象徵」用最高級 the best symbols。
1.notes_zh: 本句的 gp-perfect-passive 依批次規格標為句構 PASS（validate_bank 提示通常對應 PERF，屬預期中的 warning；完成式被動同時有完成式與被動）。第 1 部分 Compared with／to、In comparison with 都可以；寫成 Unlike … 沒有用到「相較於」的比較片語，不在可接受寫法內。「專注」寫 concentration、focus、dedication 都可以；主詞寫成不可數的 craftsmen's work 時，第 3 部分用 has long been。

Facing intense competition from machines, many craftsmen still stick to working slowly and meticulously, which makes their creations more precious.

common_errors.wrong: that makes their works even more precious
common_errors.right: which makes their works even more precious
common_errors.explanation_zh: 非限定關係子句（前面有逗號）不能用 that，要用 which。

common_errors.wrong: which make their works even more precious
common_errors.right: which makes their works even more precious
common_errors.explanation_zh: which 指前面整件事，視為單數，動詞用 makes。

traps.literal_error: … many craftsmen still insist on slow work and fine living, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「慢工細活」是成語，要譯出意思 working slowly and carefully，逐字翻成 slow work and fine living 意思全錯。

traps.zh: 這讓他們的作品更顯珍貴
traps.literal_error: …, that makes their works even more precious.
traps.explanation_zh: 「這讓…」指前面整件事，要用非限定關係子句 , which makes …；逗號後面不能用 that，也不能直接接 this makes …（兩個完整句子）。

bonus.text: Facing fierce competition from machines, many craftsmen still refuse to cut corners, and it is this patience that makes their works all the more precious.
bonus.explanation_zh: refuse to cut corners（不肯偷工減料）從反面說「慢工細活」，再用強調句 it is this patience that … 凸顯原因。屬加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「面對…」省略的主詞就是後面的「許多職人」，用分詞構句 Facing fierce competition from machines,；「這讓…」的「這」指前面整件事，英文不另起一句，用 , which makes … 補充說明；「慢工細活」譯出意思 working slowly and carefully，不要逐字翻。
2.notes_zh: 第 4 部分寫成句尾分詞 , making their works even more precious 也表達「前面整件事帶來的結果」，算作 NRREL 這一格的可接受寫法（已列入 accepted）。寫成 , and this makes … 或另起一句 This makes … 沒有用到標的句型，不在可接受寫法內。第 1 部分 Facing 和 Faced with 都可以；「慢工細活」寫 working slowly and carefully、doing slow and careful work、taking their time to work carefully 都可以。

warnings: annotations.rubric.items.1.patterns[0]: gp-perfect-passive 通常對應句構 PERF（目前 code=PASS）

1.translation: Compared with goods mass-produced in factories, the works of craftsmen have long been regarded as the best symbol of patience and focus.
1.explanation_zh: 「相較於」用 Compared with；「工廠量產的商品」用過去分詞片語 goods mass-produced in factories；「長期以來被視為」用現在完成式被動 have long been regarded as；「專注」用 focus。

2.translation: Faced with fierce competition from machines, many craftsmen still insist on working slowly and carefully, which makes their works even more precious.
2.explanation_zh: 「面對」用過去分詞構句 Faced with；「堅持慢工細活」用 insist on working slowly and carefully；「這讓…更顯珍貴」用非限定關係子句 , which makes … even more precious。

1.translation: Compared with goods mass-produced in factories, the works of craftsmen have long been regarded as the best symbol of patience and concentration.
1.explanation_zh: 「相較於……」用 Compared with ...；「工廠量產的商品」用 goods mass-produced in factories；「長期以來被視為」用現在完成被動 have long been regarded as；「最佳象徵」the best symbol。

2.translation: Faced with fierce competition from machines, many craftsmen still insist on working slowly and carefully, which makes their works even more precious.
2.explanation_zh: 「面對……」用過去分詞構句 Faced with ...；「堅持慢工細活」用 insist on working slowly and carefully；「這讓他們的作品更顯珍貴」用 which 引導的非限定子句。「慢工細活」沒有唯一對應的英文，所以信心給 medium。
